'''Darth Krayt's Tower''' was the northwest spire of the [[Temple of the Sith]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

The tower housed [[Darth Krayt's throne room]], and was formerly used to house the [[Council of First Knowledge/Legends|Council of First Knowledge]]. When [[Darth Krayt]] removed the Temple Pyramids, he exposed the [[Tower of First Knowledge/Legends|Tower of First Knowledge]]. Removing all vestiges of its Jedi past, he transformed the Tower into his personal area of the Temple. Beneath the throne room was the [[Embrace of Pain chamber]] where [[Cade Skywalker]] would be tortured in the [[Embrace of Pain|Embrace]].
